name: Ring of Lore
body:
Aura strong divination; CL 12th; Slot ring; Price 22,200 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

The wearer of the ring of lore can use legend lore and stone tell each once per week by using the command word. Additionally, the wearer gains the ability to find traps created by glyphs, runes, sigils, and symbols as a rogue can.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells find traps, legend lore, stone tell; Cost 11,000 gp
